experiment: PSE current Linux reference versus Gabriel small-signature fork
metric: paired ratio of per-invocation medians of observation throughput; latency per tick
platform_counters: unavailable on Linux; do not interpret zero as measurement
inputs: unchanged supplied benches/engine.rs deterministic batches; each invocation creates new process/state
state_comparison: complete current-run golden JSON stdout exact bytes (contains hashes and scalar trace metadata, not raw full states)
limits: three external pairs, no inferential CI
reference and fork same host/compiler, no CPU affinity/frequency lock
does not time Gabriel persistence or forecasting
golden state hashes are collision-resistant comparisons, not direct raw state bytes
clarification: The term state snapshot denotes the explicit harness field projection, not all GlobalState/internal cache fields. No timing configuration or outcome was changed by this wording clarification.
